title: Conditional Finite Discrete Doob Stationarity

claim.informal: For a finite discrete Doob transform D_ij = A_ij h_j divided by rho h_i, explicit left and right eigen-equations imply stationarity and row normalization. Under explicit positivity of rho, q, and h and entrywise nonnegativity of A, D is nonnegative and piStar is a strictly positive normalized stationary distribution.
formal_core: left eigenvector equation for stationary weights
right eigenvector equation for row sums
nonzero survivor normalization for normalized stationarity
positive rho, q, and h for the positive distribution package
entrywise nonnegative A for nonnegative Doob entries
nonempty finite index type for positive normalization

non_claims: Does not prove positivity or uniqueness of eigenmodes.
Does not prove Markov convergence, ergodicity, or mixing.
Does not prove the killed-generator case.
Does not validate any empirical H-Tilt claim.
